Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted and swapped the founding years provided by WebSurfer. WebSurfer’s results showed Noerr founded in 1950 and Korn Ferry founded in 1969, but the Planner incorrectly stated Korn Ferry was founded in 1950 and Noerr in 1969. This synthesis error led to the wrong conclusion that Korn Ferry was established first.
